ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) Districts symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 26-G in the area bound by:

      West 108th Place; South Racine Avenue; West 110th Place; South Aberdeen
      Street; the alley next south of and parallel to West 110th Place; South Bishop
      Street; West 109th Street; and South Loomis Street

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Ronnie L. Mosley
                                                          Alderman, 21st Ward
